claims.exact_statement: For every finite product-biased Boolean function and physical block A, the B09 normalization satisfies L_A=M_A+J_A and 0<=J_A<=M_A+Delta_A, where Delta_A=sum_{i in A}(h_2(p_i)+log_2(max(p_i,1-p_i))).
hypotheses: B09 normalized product Fourier and restriction conventions
A is a physical coordinate block
claims.proof_source: REPORT.md and original B09 report at adb671ffcda143fa68347806bb96e8c305621a7d

claims.exact_statement: For g(X,Y)=(-1)^(XY), with independent P(X=1)=p and fixed P(Y=1)=q in (0,1/2), the X-restriction gap satisfies J_X-M_X=4q(1-2q)p log_2(1/p)+O_q(p) as p tends to zero; hence no uniform additive O(p) correction is valid for this family.
claims.proof_source: PROOF.md; CHECK_RARE_AND_FAMILY.py is finite certified support
claims.refutes: uniform J_X<=M_X+Cp for this Boolean family

claims.exact_statement: The B09 ledger and correction are exactly additive for tensor products on genuinely disjoint physical coordinate blocks.
claims.supersedes: any ambiguous general-composition reading of B09 Section 5

claims.exact_statement: The reviewed evidence does not prove a single-use B09 correction through arbitrary Boolean composition hierarchies with changing biases, repeated variables, or overlapping witnesses.
claims.refutes: unqualified inference from disjoint tensor additivity to arbitrary Boolean composition
claims.first_unproved_line: construct an injective physical-credit assignment or a telescoping gate cocycle valid under changed biases and overlap
